title: IDS/IPS Decision Flow
description: Interactive Mermaid flowchart contrasting an out-of-band Intrusion Detection System (alert only) with an in-line Intrusion Prevention System (drop, log, terminate), plus a pros/cons comparison panel.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity
chapter_title: "Network Security Foundations: Protocols, Firewalls, and Detection"

learningObjectives: Distinguish out-of-band detection (IDS) from in-line prevention (IPS).
Explain why an IDS cannot block traffic while an IPS can.
Weigh the availability and false-positive trade-offs of placing a sensor in the live data path.
educational.prerequisites: Basic familiarity with packets, switches, and firewalls.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions in the lesson plan ask students to choose IDS vs IPS for a given availability requirement.
misconceptionsAddressed: Believing an IDS blocks attacks (it only alerts).
Ignoring that an in-line IPS is a single point of failure and a source of false-positive outages.
